title: Step 8 - Enhancing Text Classification: Stemming for Efficient Feature Matrices

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this art tutorial.

cues.en: So we did the big part of the cleaning process.
We started by creating this corpus here.
Then we put all the words in lower cases, then we removed all the numbers, all the punctuation and we also removed all the non-relevant words.
cues.zh: 再全小寫、去數字、去標點，也去無關詞。

cues.en: And finally, we took the roots of all the words in the 1000 reviews.
cues.zh: 最後取一千則評論各詞詞根。

cues.en: So all these steps considerably simplify the words in the reviews.
So thanks to all these steps here, all the simplifications, well, our final sparse matrix of features will get a much smaller number of columns.
cues.zh: 這些步驟讓最終稀疏特徵矩陣欄數少很多。

cues.en: So that's good for our algorithm, because we reduce sparsity, and now we have one final little step to do that will not be done to simplify even more of the corpus,
cues.zh: 對演算法很好，降低稀疏性；最後小步驟不是再簡化 corpus，

cues.en: but that just consists of removing the extra spaces.
Because, by doing all these simplifications here, well, you know we removed some things, and those things that were removed could actually have been replaced by a space.
cues.zh: 因為前面移除的東西，可能被空格取代。

cues.en: And that would cause an extra space in the review, and therefore, if we want to have perfectly clean reviews, we must remove these extra spaces.
cues.zh: 造成評論多餘空格，要完美乾淨，就得去掉。

cues.en: If we remove all the extra spaces, well, the columns in our final sparse matrix of features will only contain the words that are relevant, and will not contain any space or anything else.
cues.zh: 移除後，最終矩陣欄只含有意義詞，沒有空格或其他。

cues.en: So, that's what we will remove in this final step of the cleaning process.
So, let's do it.
Again, it's going to be very simple.
We'll copy this line here, copy and paste it below and replace STEM document here, by strip wide space.
cues.zh: 複製這行貼下，把 stemDocument 換 stripWhitespace。

cues.en: Here it is. Pressing enter and all good.
Final step, ready to be executed.

Press and command here.

And the second thing we see very clearly is, the stemming of course, because we hardly recognize the words here.
cues.zh: 第二，當然是詞幹提取，詞幾乎認不出。

cues.en: 'Bucks' was replaced by 'buck'.
You know, it's not only about the past tense of verbs, it's also about the singular and plurals of nouns.
cues.zh: 不只是動詞過去式，也處理名詞單複數。

cues.en: So, 'bucks' became 'buck' and head was not replaced because the root of head is head, so, that's why we kept head here.
cues.zh: bucks 變 buck，head 沒改，因為根部就是 head。

cues.en: And then, uh, really, really with a 'Y' became really with an 'I'.

cues.en: So, that's how 'R' simply integrated the root.
So that's okay, it's not a mistake.
And finally, 'expect better in food' were not replaced. Because you know, these are kind of already the roots of the words and we cannot really simplify the words more.
cues.zh: 最後 expect、better、food 沒改，因為已接近詞根，不能再簡化。
